purpose: Four optional post-scene plain-language projections of source-bound CoAll families, retaining technical sources, claims, nonclaims, and projection losses; no injected interlude before character needs it.

lenses.technical_fact: CoMap R0 registers 56 objects and 61 typed relations from bounded public registries.
lenses.plain_language: A map can show the paths someone recorded without containing every road that exists.
lenses.narrative_need: The Cartographer opens a map after choosing a route.
lenses.evidence_limit: Registered relations are not proof of universal coverage, equivalence, live sync, or authority.
lenses.projection_loss: The short analogy omits exact object IDs, edge types, source timestamps, and registered coverage boundaries.

lenses.technical_fact: CoTheoryAll's R0 explores whether quantum structure is fundamental or an observer-relative projection of deeper relations.
lenses.plain_language: What if the way we look at the world changes the picture we make of it?
lenses.narrative_need: A missing part of the map invites a question about descriptions and reality.
lenses.evidence_limit: A fictional question is not scientific confirmation that reality is non-quantum.
lenses.projection_loss: This ordinary-language question drops mathematical definitions, competing models, controls, and falsifying predictions.

lenses.technical_fact: CoGlukey careers propose durable identity, bounded budgets, sleep on no meaningful change, and reawakening on material need.
lenses.plain_language: A good helper keeps a doorway usable and can rest until someone needs another repair.
lenses.narrative_need: The Beetle is learning to be an available adviser rather than the owner of the route.
lenses.evidence_limit: This is a proposed stewardship relation, not an operating improvement club or autonomous worker.
lenses.projection_loss: The metaphor drops qualification, budget, election, receiver, and recovery contracts.

lenses.technical_fact: The source registry lists 10 highlighted assets with different readiness states and explicit no-canon rails.
lenses.plain_language: Ten named curiosities can be worth exploring without being ten proven treasures.
lenses.narrative_need: The map makes some places visible but does not declare every bright mark trustworthy.
lenses.evidence_limit: A source highlight is not validated, adopted, public-release-ready, or necessarily central to the reader.
lenses.projection_loss: The analogy suppresses detailed per-asset status, currentness, and privacy rules.

deferred_topic_rail: Whale, God, CoStairHeaven, alien minds and other motifs are optional elsewhere. Do not introduce them here as competing standalone plots.
